name: [NEW] Ant Mount
desc:
Welcome to Ant Mountain!🐜

Have you ever thought of being a little ant and exploring everything? Exactly, because here there is beauty, obstacles, scenery, and other horrors.

Lots of fun things like:
A mission to save baby bees, the thrill of riding the Queen Bee with friends, and many other exciting things!

There's a lot of trouble here, so what else are you waiting for?
